subject: math
source: Cambridge IGCSE Mathematics 0580 (Extended) syllabus 2025–2027, Cambridge International

weeks.topic: Algebraic fractions: simplifying, adding, subtracting and solving
objectives: Simplify and combine algebraic fractions
Solve equations involving algebraic fractions

weeks.topic: Simultaneous equations: one linear and one quadratic
objectives: Solve linear–quadratic simultaneous equations algebraically
Interpret solutions as intersection points

weeks.topic: Surds: simplifying and rationalising the denominator
objectives: Simplify expressions with surds
Rationalise denominators of the form a/√b and a/(b + √c)

weeks.topic: Exponential growth and decay
objectives: Model growth and decay with multipliers
Solve problems involving depreciation and population change

weeks.topic: Functions: notation, domain, range, composite and inverse functions
objectives: Use function notation f(x)
Find composite functions fg(x) and inverse functions f⁻¹(x)

weeks.topic: Graphical methods: tangents, gradients and solving equations from graphs
objectives: Estimate gradients by drawing tangents
Use graphs to solve equations and find turning points

weeks.topic: Differentiation: gradient functions and turning points of polynomials
objectives: Differentiate axⁿ and polynomial functions
Find and classify turning points

weeks.topic: Non-right-angled trigonometry: sine rule, cosine rule and area ½ab sin C
objectives: Use the sine and cosine rules to find sides and angles
Calculate the area of any triangle

weeks.topic: Trigonometric graphs and equations from 0° to 360°
objectives: Sketch graphs of sine, cosine and tangent
Solve simple trigonometric equations in a given interval

weeks.topic: Pythagoras and trigonometry in three dimensions
objectives: Find lengths and angles in 3D shapes
Calculate the angle between a line and a plane

weeks.topic: Vectors: notation, magnitude and vector geometry
objectives: Add, subtract and scale vectors
Use vectors to prove geometric results

weeks.topic: Circle theorems: cyclic quadrilaterals, alternate segment and chord properties
objectives: Apply all circle theorems with reasons
Use symmetry properties of chords and tangents

weeks.topic: Parallel and perpendicular lines; perpendicular bisectors
objectives: Find equations of parallel and perpendicular lines
Find the perpendicular bisector of a line segment

weeks.topic: Cumulative frequency, quartiles and box plots
objectives: Draw and interpret cumulative frequency diagrams
Find median, quartiles and interquartile range

weeks.topic: Term 1 review: algebra, functions, calculus, trigonometry and vectors
objectives: Consolidate Term 1 topics with mixed questions
Correct common errors

weeks.topic: Histograms with unequal class widths
objectives: Draw histograms using frequency density
Interpret histograms to estimate frequencies

weeks.topic: Grouped data: estimated mean, modal class and class containing the median
objectives: Estimate the mean from a grouped frequency table
Identify the modal class and median class

weeks.topic: Conditional probability
objectives: Calculate conditional probabilities from tables, trees and Venn diagrams
Solve problems involving dependent events

weeks.topic: Combined transformations and describing transformations fully
objectives: Perform successive transformations
Identify the single transformation equivalent to a combination

weeks.topic: Compound measures: speed, density and pressure
objectives: Use formulae for speed, density and pressure
Convert between units including area and volume units

weeks.topic: Recurring decimals and bounds in multi-step problems
objectives: Convert recurring decimals to fractions
Apply upper and lower bounds in formulae

weeks.topic: Sketching quadratic graphs: roots, intercepts and turning points
objectives: Use completed-square form to find turning points
Sketch quadratics showing key features

weeks.topic: Non-calculator problem solving: Paper 2 multi-step questions
objectives: Use efficient mental and written methods
Solve unfamiliar multi-step problems without a calculator

weeks.topic: Calculator problem solving: Paper 4 modelling questions
objectives: Model real situations with algebra and geometry
Give answers to appropriate accuracy

weeks.topic: Mathematical reasoning and proof across topics
objectives: Construct algebraic and geometric arguments
Show that results hold using clear steps

weeks.topic: Exam technique: command words, working and accuracy
objectives: Interpret command words such as calculate, show and explain
Avoid premature rounding and lost method marks

weeks.topic: Mock exams: full Paper 2 and Paper 4 (Extended)
objectives: Sit full mock papers under exam conditions
Analyse results to plan revision

weeks.topic: Revision: number (types, fractions, percentages, bounds, standard form)
objectives: Practise number topics across both papers
Fix recurring errors in percentages and bounds

weeks.topic: Revision: algebra and graphs (equations, functions, sequences, calculus)
objectives: Revise solving equations and manipulating expressions
Practise functions and differentiation questions

weeks.topic: Revision: coordinate geometry and geometry (angles, circles, constructions)
objectives: Revise lines, circle theorems and similarity
Give geometric reasons accurately

weeks.topic: Revision: mensuration and trigonometry
objectives: Practise area, volume and arc problems
Revise sine and cosine rules and 3D trigonometry

weeks.topic: Revision: transformations, vectors and probability
objectives: Practise describing transformations and vector proofs
Revise combined and conditional probability

weeks.topic: Revision: statistics (averages, charts, cumulative frequency, histograms)
objectives: Interpret statistical diagrams
Practise estimated mean and histogram questions

weeks.topic: Final exams: Paper 2 (Extended, non-calculator)
objectives: Sit Paper 2 applying non-calculator methods
Manage time across all questions

weeks.topic: Final exams: Paper 4 (Extended, calculator)
objectives: Sit Paper 4 with structured problem-solving questions
Check answers and accuracy

weeks.topic: Exam season: targeted practice between papers
objectives: Review errors from the papers already taken
Keep skills sharp with short practice sets

weeks.topic: Exam season close: reflection and bridge to A Level / IB Mathematics
objectives: Reflect on the IGCSE course
Preview algebra skills needed for post-16 maths
